## Declarations

### Schema

Type. `import type { Schema } from "@nowaki-dev/markdoc";`

```ts
export type Schema = {
    render?: string;
    attributes?: Record<string, unknown>;
    children?: string[];
    selfClosing?: boolean;
    inline?: boolean;
    [key: string]: unknown;
};
```

A Markdoc tag or node schema. `render` names an HTML element (lowercase) or an export of the
`components` module (capitalized). See https://markdoc.dev/docs/tags.

Documented members:

- `render`: The HTML element (lowercase) or `components` export (capitalized) to render.
- `attributes`: The attributes the tag accepts, by name (Markdoc attribute schemas).
- `children`: The node types allowed as children.
- `selfClosing`: The tag has no closing tag (`{% name /%}`).
- `inline`: The tag renders inline, inside a paragraph.

Used by: [`MarkdocOptions`](#markdocoptions).

### MarkdocOptions

Type. `import type { MarkdocOptions } from "@nowaki-dev/markdoc";`

```ts
export type MarkdocOptions = {
    components?: string;
    tags?: Record<string, Schema>;
    nodes?: Record<string, Schema>;
    variables?: Record<string, unknown>;
    functions?: Record<string, unknown>;
    partials?: Record<string, unknown>;
    parseFrontmatter?: (raw: string, format: "yaml" | "toml") => Record<string, unknown>;
    root?: string;
};
```

The options of [`markdoc`](#markdoc).

Documented members:

- `components`: The module (path from the app root) whose exports render capitalized tags, like
  `"./markdoc/components.tsx"`. Required when the schema renders a component.
- `tags`: Custom tags: `{% callout type="note" %}…{% /callout %}`.
- `nodes`: Overrides for Markdoc's built-in nodes (heading, fence, link, …).
- `variables`: Variables (`{% $name %}`); `$frontmatter` is the file's own frontmatter.
- `functions`: Markdoc functions (`{% if equals($a, 1) %}`).
- `partials`: Markdoc partials by file name (`{% partial file="header.mdoc" /%}`).
- `parseFrontmatter`: Parses the frontmatter text (`format` is "yaml" for `---`, "toml" for `+++`). The built-in
  reader handles flat key/value pairs and lists of scalars.
- `root`: The app root `components` is relative to (default: the working directory).

Uses: [`Schema`](#schema).

Used by: [`markdoc`](#markdoc), [`compileMarkdoc`](#compilemarkdoc).

### markdoc

Function. `import { markdoc } from "@nowaki-dev/markdoc";`

```ts
export function markdoc(options?: MarkdocOptions): NowakiPlugin;
```

The plugin. Compiles `.mdoc` files at build / dev time into modules that render with Preact.
Throws a TypeError on invalid options.

Example:

```tsx
plugins: [markdoc({ components: "./markdoc/components.tsx", tags })] // nowaki.config.mjs
```

Uses: [`MarkdocOptions`](#markdocoptions), [`NowakiPlugin`](runtime-config.md#nowakiplugin).

### compileMarkdoc

Function. `import { compileMarkdoc } from "@nowaki-dev/markdoc";`

```ts
export function compileMarkdoc(source: string, id: string, options?: MarkdocOptions): string;
```

Compiles one `.mdoc` source (`id` is its path) to the TSX module the plugin emits. Throws on
validation errors.

Uses: [`MarkdocOptions`](#markdocoptions).
